Name: They Deserve It Too - Portraits for Vendors
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
This mod adds portraits to every single vendor in [i]Stardew Valley[/i] who hasn't already gotten one.

Part of the [i]They Deserve It Too[/i] series, aiming to give portraits to various [i]SDV[/i] characters:
[list]
[*][b][i]Portraits for Vendors[/i][/b]: You are here![/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35358][i]Portraits for Extras[/i][/url]: Give portraits to all extra characters, from event characters to festival attendees.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37152][i]Portraits for Central Station[/i][/url]: Give portraits to all the tourists who visit the [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000]Central Station[/url][/i] by[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild] Pathoschild[/url].[/*]
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48630]Portraits for East Scarp[/url][/i]: Give portraits to interactable characters who appear in [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url][/i] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]Lemurkat[/url]. [/*]
[/list][size=6][b]L[/b][/size][size=5][b]atest Update[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Added winter outfits for select vendors.[/*]
[/list]      [img]https://i.imgur.com/DqphTTA.png[/img]
[b][color=#dd7e6b][size=6]F[/size][size=5]eatures[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]More than 16 custom portraits to adorn your shop menu.[/*]
[*]Brand new shop greetings for vendors who previously lacked them.[/*]
[*]Randomly rotates attendants each day for selected vendors.[/*]
[*]Adds dialogue box and portrait for the Old Mariner.[/*]
[*]Support for various mods that change vendors' appearances.[/*]
[*]Fully configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i][/url].[/*]
[/list][b][color=#ffe599][size=6]M[/size][/color][size=5][color=#ffe599]ods Support[/color][/size]
[/b][b][i]Portraits for Vendors[/i][/b]  will automatically adjust its portraits when the following mods are installed:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787][i]East Scarp Remastered[/i][/url]. An expansion where heart meets the ocean![/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17364][i]Hat Mouse and Friends[/i][/url]. Bring over 14 new adorable Hat Mice to take over hat shop duty![/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8706][i]Hippie Desert Trader[/i][/url]. Swap out the desert trader's tent with a chill hippie trailer, complete with a cute snake companion![/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2643][i]Night Market Cat Boat[/i][/url]. Change the decoration seller at the Night Market into an orange cat with an optional sailor hat![/*]
[/list]It also provide config option to match the art style of the following mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32385][i]Rose and the Alchemist[/i][/url]. Enjoy two charming storylines full of events and silly shenanigans![/*]
[/list]You might also want to explore other mods that provide portraits for alternative vendors or style:
[list]
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27730][i]Island Trader Sialia Portrait[/i][/url]. Give a selection of portraits for the version of Island Trader in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708][i]Emyn's Diverse Ginger Island[/i][/url].[/*]
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14916][i]Dwarf Portrait Replacement[/i][/url]. Give the Dwarf and various other Dwarf custom NPCs more accurate and expressive portraits![/*]
[/list][color=#b6d7a8]﻿[b][size=6]I[/size][size=5]nstallation[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][i]Content Patcher[/i][/url]﻿ installed.[/*]
[*]Download [b][i]Portraits for Vendors[/i][/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded file into the game's [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete [font=Lucida Sans Unicode][CP] Portraits for Vendors[/font] from your Mods folder.

[b][color=#a2c4c9][size=6]C[/size][size=5]ompatibility[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Only works with [i]Stardew Valley[/i] version 1.6 and later.[/*]
[*]May conflict with others that modify the vanilla vendors' portraits and dialogues. If conflicts occur, you can disable the affected portraits through the config menu.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#9fc5e8][size=6]T[/size][size=5]ranslations[/size][/color][/b]
This mod uses i18n. If you want to make a translation for it, feel free to either give it to me (so I could incorporate it into the mod) or upload them yourself (do tell me so I can link to them!).

[b][color=#b4a7d6][size=6]C[/size][size=5]redits[/size][/color][/b]
The majority of the default portraits in this mod were created by me. The rest are works from various artists, including [url=https://twitter.com/AndiasRakhman]Andias Rakhman[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262]6480[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/77325553]LavenderSkelly[/url], for whom I'm very grateful for adding their flair into the mix. A more detailed breakdown of credits for each file can be found in Credits.xlsx within the mod's assets folder.

Many, many thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url] for providing alternate portraits in their style for all the default portraits.
